title: Complete procurement and financial family presets for existing controlled datasets
description: Stage 2 functional preset coverage. ERP-297 and ERP-298 created seven controlled datasets but their allowed paths excluded ReportConfigurationPresetCatalog.cs; current manifest lacks those presets. Add corresponding immutable presets through existing orchestration only. No new algorithms/entities/schema/migrations, production operations, secrets/env, permissions expansion or old entry switch. Tests may seed only explicitly guarded NEWERP_AUTOTEST_* databases on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance. Necessary security repair before exposing these presets: FinancialStatementReportConfigurationDatasetProvider and ArAgingReportConfigurationDatasetProvider currently perform menu-only checks and call legacy global queries; implement fail-closed current-user data scope using existing scope service, never post-filter aggregated global financial data.
acceptance_criteria: Add immutable user-visible presets for all registry entries backed by ERP-297 purchase-order/supplier-aging/supplier-exposure and ERP-298 balance-sheet/income-statement/cash-flow/ar-aging controlled providers. Use live catalog field/filter keys, original field order and meaningful defaults; do not create new queries or dedicated report UI/exporters.

Preset discovery and private copying must reuse original menu/data/column permission checks and existing definition validation; inaccessible datasets are hidden and revoked access fails closed. Preserve original currency/unit and summary scope, retaining legacy routes and existing audit.

Verify every related registry key resolves to a valid authorized preset/private definition and generic preview/export across mocked providers and isolated SQL fixtures; cover absent/revoked permissions, immutable seeds, invalid keys and empty data. Execute related tests, safe Release build/unit suite and scheduler self-test/contracts. Presence is readiness, never parity-passed or full-stage acceptance; genuine browser/SQL gaps remain unverified.

Before exposing ERP-298 financial presets, fix its four dataset providers current-user data-scope boundary: current EnsureAuthorizedAsync validates only the menu and calls unscoped legacy financial queries. Resolve existing SalespersonDataScopeService scope on every catalog/preview/export path; reject restricted or unresolved scope before any global legacy query unless an already proven scoped service exists. Do not expand user permissions or filter global summaries after aggregation. Add restricted-user-with-valid-menu and revoked-scope tests asserting no global query/row leakage; keep authorized full-scope behavior and old routes intact.
implementation_evidence: Read ERP-297/298 task definitions, current ReportConfigurationPresetManifest and ReportMigrationRegistryDtos.cs; provider registrations exist, procurement/financial preset keys are absent. New tasks 302/303 cover separate remaining workflow/reconciliation families.

recovery_context.strategy: Validate current-user scope before unscoped query, reject restricted scope with bounded failure and prove no query executed; preserve authorized full-scope existing calculations.
